::: {.callout-note}
## Working research proposition
The commissioning brief includes province-wide availability around 1995 and a 2008 program-review synthesis as later reference points. Neither is written up as history here.
:::

## What this chapter is for

Later work can track how CSIL changed after a design/pilot period: eligibility, administration, reviews, and public documentation. This chapter should stay source-led and should not become a policy-recommendation page.

## Evidence status

- **Documented facts:** none recorded on this page yet.
- **Bibliographically confirmed (copy sought):** [Choice in Supports for Independent Living Review Program: Synthesis Report](../sources/wanted-2008-program-review.qmd) (Ministry of Health Services / James Murtagh Consulting, November 2008).
- **Open questions:** when and how CSIL became available province-wide; which later reviews are public; what administrative homes the program had after the mid-1990s.
